question: Should sidebar attention dismissals remain browser-local and signature-keyed, rather than becoming gateway-owned acknowledgements or time-bounded snoozes?
rationale: The implementation can enforce whichever model is chosen, but whether operational and authentication warnings may remain hidden on one browser until their entity signature changes is a product and UX policy choice.

options.title: Approve Local Dismissals
options.body: Keep the proposed browser-local signature model after fixing query-route isolation and supplying full lifecycle proof.

options.title: Require Gateway Acknowledgements
options.body: Persist acknowledgement through a gateway-owned contract so visibility follows the gateway rather than one browser profile.

options.title: Use Time-Bounded Snoozes
options.body: Replace indefinite signature dismissals with an explicit duration so unresolved warnings automatically return.

recommendation.title: Approve Local Dismissals
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed browser-local signature model after fixing query-route isolation and supplying full lifecycle proof.
